Vendored from [`aurora-ui`](https://github.com/Zijian-Ni/aurora-ui) so the static viewer has **zero runtime dependencies** and works from `file://` or any static host.

Do not edit these files here — change them upstream and recopy.

- `aurora-ui.css` — tokens + v1 components
- `aurora-ui.v2.css` — plugin-grade layer (`.bento` `.plug-card` `.readout` `.lamp` `.palette`)
- `aurora-ui.js` — theme, tilt, ⌘K `CommandPalette`, toast, readout helpers
